Subject: Onboarding: invoice submission channel & sample template

Hi Sean,

Thanks for taking us through the onboarding checklist yesterday. Procurement has a quick follow up: can you confirm whether Redwood prefers vendors to submit invoices via the portal or via email (we have internal constraints that sometimes force email fallback)?

Attaching our current invoice export (CB-Invoice-Sample.csv) and our onboarding form (ClearBridge_Onboarding_Form_v2.pdf) so your team can validate fields. A few specific questions from our AP team:
- Do you require PO numbers to be in a single field or can they be a semicolon-separated list in the PO column?
- Do you need invoice line items split into multiple rows, or can we submit a single description per invoice with embedded itemization?
- Are there mandatory header fields we must populate for auto-ingest?

We'd like to go live next week if portal setup is straightforward. If email is required, what subject conventions and attachment naming do you need to ensure no processing delays?

Thanks,
Aisha Khan
Head of Finance Ops
ClearBridge Systems

Attachments: CB-Invoice-Sample.csv, ClearBridge_Onboarding_Form_v2.pdf

From: sean_gallagher@redwood.ai
To: Aisha Khan <aisha.khan@clearbridge.com>
Cc: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai, monica_patel@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 18 Sep 2026 12:10:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Onboarding: invoice submission channel & sample template

Hi Aisha,

Appreciate the sample files. Short answers up front: we recommend portal-first with an email fallback for legacy systems. Portal gives you deterministic ACKs and automatic PO matching, which cuts down exceptions. That said, many vendors use email as a fallback and we have robust subject/attachment parsing rules.

Quick checklist and answers to your questions:
- PO field: preferred as a single PO field per invoice for deterministic matching. If you must include multiple POs, use a semicolon delimiter and include a separate header column called PO_List.
- Line items: we prefer one row per line item for full ledger reconciliation. Single-line invoices are supported but increase manual exceptions.
- Mandatory headers for auto-ingest: InvoiceNumber, InvoiceDate (YYYY-MM-DD), SupplierID, Currency, PO (or PO_List), LineItemDescription, LineItemQty, LineItemUnitPrice.

If you go email-first: subject convention should be "Invoice: <SupplierID> <InvoiceNumber>" and attachments must be CSV or PDF with filename including SupplierID and InvoiceNumber. See attached RBW-compact-template.csv for our compact CSV layout.

Next steps I propose:
1) You confirm whether ClearBridge can export in the compact CSV layout (sample attached).
2) Vanessa will validate PO stamping and cross-entity visibility if you have multiple legal entities.
3) We schedule a 30-min onboarding call to flip the portal switch.

Can you share who will own the portal admin access? Once we have that we can enable test mode.

Best,
Sean Gallagher
Sr. Partner Solutions
Redwood Inference

Attachment: RBW-compact-template.csv
